name: What types of tile are best for bathroom floors and walls?

mainEntity.name: What types of tile are best for bathroom floors and walls?

acceptedAnswer.text: For bathroom floors, porcelain or ceramic tiles are excellent choices due to their durability, water resistance, and wide range of styles. They are also slip-resistant when textured or honed. For walls, ceramic, porcelain, and natural stone (like marble or travertine) are popular. Natural stone offers a luxurious look but requires sealing. When making your selection, consider the area's moisture exposure and foot traffic. For example, a shower floor needs higher slip resistance than a powder room wall. Our team can help you navigate these options to ensure the best fit for your specific bathroom needs and aesthetic preferences.
acceptedAnswer.description: Porcelain and ceramic tiles are ideal for bathroom floors and walls due to their water resistance and durability. Natural stone is also an option for walls but requires maintenance.
